gaps.detail: HanlinExpoUI peers now match the existing stable tooling pins, with no resolved dependency changes. File empty/missing distinction and runtime deadline/artifact typings are source-corrected; actual JS->module->native per-API and Metro/device coverage remain required.

Native legacy executeRuntime now validates all five canonical kinds (plus the explicit Python alias) and propagates cancellation/nonzero exit/timeout; actual backend regression tests are pending. Full JS-to-native structured receipt coverage remains open.

Generic RuntimeKind.shell still uses the linked native string parser; the public command-string tool uses the portable-shell route. Align the documented source semantics without adding another shell engine.

Generic NS executeRuntime now uses the same JSON request/full receipt boundary as Expo, with typed generated facade and session-owned cooperative cancellation. Actual VM/metadata/backend acceptance is pending; legacy callbacks retain string semantics.
NativeScript has one active session and process-environment mutation; no concurrent-isolate or process-isolation claim.

NS headless-action provider now explicitly sets canPresentUI=false; foreground default remains true. Actual share-sheet rejection regression is pending. MiniApp context still uses userGesturePresent=false; full invocation context and all OS-prompt services require separate validation.
hasCapability returns personal-host policy, not OS/service availability. The17 SystemServicesBroker declarations have no generic NS/Expo Host binding in these inspected adapters.
Installed device Host/bridge versions and signed extension entitlements remain unverified here; source manifests are not IPA evidence.
